name: life-story
who: The man in every scene is the man in the two attached reference photos: Marko, slim, completely bald head, clean-shaven, sometimes glasses; keep his face exactly as in the photos. He likes loose Indian kurta shirts in white, magenta or orange. Only one person looks like him; others are different people.
style: Photorealistic cinematic photograph, natural light, landscape 16:9, rich warm colours, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos.

items.name: 31-singing-bowls
items.scene: Marko in an orange kurta sits cross-legged playing large brass singing bowls in a bright room with Tibetan paintings, eyes half closed, sound healing.

items.name: 32-candle-dj
items.scene: Marko in a white linen kurta plays a DJ set at a mixer surrounded by many candles in an old stone room with arched windows, eyes closed, deep in the music.

items.name: 33-matrimandir-white
items.scene: Marko dressed all in white sits in meditation on the grass in front of the huge golden sphere of the Matrimandir in Auroville, morning light.

items.name: 34-frame-drum-dark
items.scene: Marko in black plays a big frame drum in a dim wooden room, warm lamp light on the drum skin, concentrated.

items.name: 35-yoga-class
items.scene: Marko teaches a calm yoga class in a bright hall with big windows onto a garden, students on mats, gentle morning light.

items.name: 36-white-shawl
items.scene: Marko wrapped in a white shawl sits in meditation on a veranda at dawn, green garden behind, peaceful.

items.name: 37-ecstatic-dance-croatia
items.scene: An ecstatic dance gathering on the Croatian coast at sunset, people dancing barefoot on a wooden deck by the sea, Marko as the DJ with headphones, joyful.

items.name: 38-kirtan-hall-of-light
items.scene: A kirtan evening in a hall with warm lights: Marko sings and plays harmonium, a woman sings beside him, people sit on cushions and sing along.

items.name: 39-dome-acrobatics
items.scene: Marko balances standing on top of a geodesic dome climbing frame against a deep blue sky, arms open, playful and strong.

items.name: 40-headstand
items.scene: Marko holds a perfect yoga headstand in a quiet room with a warm wall lamp, calm and focused.

items.name: 41-macro-photographer
items.scene: Marko lies on the ground in a tropical garden photographing a small lizard with a macro lens, flowers around him, soft green light.

items.name: 42-night-sky-palms
items.scene: Marko stands with a camera on a tripod under a deep blue night sky full of stars, silhouettes of palm trees, Auroville at night.

items.name: 43-filming-matrimandir
items.scene: Marko films with a cinema camera on a tripod near the golden disks of the Matrimandir, black and white mood, concentrated.

items.name: 44-djembe-lake
items.scene: Marko and a friend play djembe drums together on the shore of a calm lake at dusk, reflections on the water.

items.name: 45-fire-ceremony
items.scene: A night fire ceremony: a big bonfire in a circle of people, Marko playing frame drum, sparks rising, warm faces.

items.name: 46-tea-ceremony
items.scene: Marko pours tea in a slow tea ceremony at a low wooden table with small bowls, morning sun, serene.
